entries.name: Frost · 焦糖
entries.subject: baby caramel dachshund
entries.feature: two broad floppy rounded ears framing one elongated soft muzzle
entries.rationale: 保留焦糖腊肠犬的身份，作为理解目标与分派任务的主伙伴。

entries.name: Her Motion
entries.subject: baby flamingo
entries.feature: one broad curved neck folded into a soft upright S, with a blunt rounded beak
entries.rationale: 柔软弧线呼应伸展、瑜伽与身体平衡。

entries.name: 练了吗
entries.subject: sturdy friendly baby bear
entries.feature: two large rounded ears and a compact broad face
entries.rationale: 结实但友善的小熊代表力量训练与耐心陪练。

entries.name: 跑步路线规划
entries.subject: curious baby toucan
entries.feature: one oversized pill-shaped rounded beak pointing gently toward the open side
entries.rationale: 探路的小鸟，用醒目的嘴形表达出发和方向。

entries.name: 跑步决策教练
entries.subject: bright baby rabbit
entries.rationale: 轻快的小兔代表跑步，用稳定表情传达有节制的训练决策。

entries.name: Apple Health 本地同步
entries.subject: personified plump apple
entries.feature: a softly heart-shaped apple body with one broad blunt leaf, clearly not a corporate logo
entries.rationale: 苹果承接健康数据入口；不是 Apple 官方标志。

entries.name: MediaPipe 动作信号
entries.subject: playful baby gecko
entries.feature: two oversized rounded eyes above a broad smooth head, with one simple broad bent forearm
entries.rationale: 灵活的小壁虎代表姿态观察，避免把关键点画成复杂线路。

entries.name: 耐力训练校验器
entries.subject: calm baby tortoise
entries.feature: one broad smooth domed shell with no shell pattern
entries.rationale: 慢而稳的乌龟代表训练安全与耐力边界。

entries.name: 包装食品查询
entries.subject: friendly personified little milk carton
entries.feature: a squat soft rectangular body with a single broad folded top, rounded corners and no printing
entries.rationale: 拟人包装盒让条码与营养标签查询一眼可认。

entries.name: Garmin 只读同步
entries.subject: attentive baby penguin
entries.feature: one continuous pale face-and-belly region on a compact upright body
entries.rationale: 整洁可靠的小企鹅代表可穿戴数据读取，不使用 Garmin 商标。

entries.name: 中国食品与健康解析
entries.subject: personified baby broccoli
entries.feature: a single merged cloud-shaped crown with only three broad rounded lobes and a short thick stalk face
entries.rationale: 绿色蔬菜对应中国食品参考库与日常营养资料。

entries.name: 户外运动窗口
entries.subject: cheerful personified sunflower
entries.feature: one large round face surrounded by a single continuous scalloped crown of broad blunt petals
entries.rationale: 向日葵把天气、日照和适合出门的时间窗口联系起来。

entries.name: Strava 训练回放
entries.subject: lively baby fox
entries.feature: one broad pale cheek region and two short ears with very blunt rounded ends
entries.rationale: 活泼狐狸对应训练回顾，用独立动物形象避开 Strava 商标。

entries.name: 睡眠侦探
entries.subject: sleepy baby owl
entries.feature: one broad merged binocular-shaped face disk with no feather markings
entries.rationale: 夜行猫头鹰对应睡眠观察，保持安静而非侦探装扮。

entries.name: 中国饮食镜头
entries.subject: personified little rice bowl
entries.feature: a broad half-circle bowl face topped by one single smooth mound of rice with no individual grains
entries.rationale: 米饭碗对应拍餐食、确认菜名与份量。

entries.name: wger 训练计划
entries.subject: strong gentle baby gorilla
entries.feature: one broad rounded head and a single pale face region
entries.rationale: 温和的大猩猩代表有计划的力量训练，与练了吗的小熊区分。

entries.name: Mealie 恢复厨房
entries.subject: friendly personified little mushroom
entries.feature: one broad rounded dome cap over a single plump short stalk face, no spots
entries.rationale: 朴实蘑菇代表食谱与恢复餐，保持可爱的食物形象。
